annotations.title: Fit an office or residential building on a parcel (Wai Building Intelligence)

description: Wai's rule engine (not the AI) fits an office building or a residential block on a real parcel: setbacks taken off, the largest footprint within the plan depth limits, site coverage (TAKS), floor-area ratio (KAKS / FAR) and height limits applied, storeys, gross / net floor area, workplaces or flats, indicative parking, and the checks (footprint inside the parcel, setbacks, coverage, FAR, height). Give the parcel as lat / lng corner points, or one point with the parcel size. Zoning values default to typical values unless given - say so. The georeferenced IFC4, the DXF site plan (UTM) and the floors are in Wai. Pre-design screening, not an architectural design or a zoning approval. Answer with the returned numbers, not an estimate made before the call.
